__comment: The mast only, and no variant key at all: it is the same box whichever of the sixteen angles the head is turned to, so every rotation matches this one entry. The head is drawn by RelaySignalRenderer, because a blockstate y only turns in quarters and this block turns in 22.5 degree steps - see SignalRotation. Both halves are generated from housing.json; the item model still parents the whole thing so the item looks complete.
